items.statement: No theorem in positive characteristic is claimed.
No PC1 statement survives after allowing c=0; the locked c=0 family gives infinite T_2.
No PC1 statement survives after allowing a=0; the locked triangular degeneration forgets the second coordinate and gives infinite T_2.
No displayed b_j may vanish; support is the actual collected support with distinct exponents.
No constant or repeated exponent is counted as a nonconstant support term; the polynomial is collected before s is defined.
No coefficient a, c, or b_j is assumed to belong to Γ.
No additive closure of Γ is assumed or used.
Finite rank does not mean finite generation, and no finite-generation hypothesis is added.
Support size is not asserted to be invariant under affine or polynomial conjugacy.
No numerical optimality of A, S_q, S_*, M, or any displayed bound is claimed.
No effective enumeration algorithm, computable survivor list, or height bound is claimed.
No classification of periodic points, rational periodic points, integral cycles, or all coefficients with infinite short windows is claimed.
No theorem is claimed for arbitrary general-polynomial Hénon maps, compositions of Hénon maps, or arbitrary polynomial automorphisms.
No classification of all free chains after dropping a≠0, c≠0, or the collected-support hypotheses is claimed.
PC2 sharpness concerns the number of transitions and does not imply numerical optimality of PC1.
The optional rank-zero roots-of-unity observation is not the headline and is not a classification of torsion examples.
Amoroso–Viada bounds only nondegenerate unit-equation solutions; every degenerate contribution is supplied by the internal union analysis.
ESS is a historical comparison, not the source of the locked Paper16 constants.
All cited arithmetic-dynamics papers other than Amoroso–Viada are boundary sources and prove no part of PC1–PC3.
The bounded no-collision search is not a priority claim, exhaustive bibliography, or universal absence proof.
No scientific computation, CAS run, scan, experiment, code artifact, data artifact, result artifact, or figure is theorem evidence.
No paper plan, TeX, bibliography, manuscript, compilation, finalization, release, submission, upload, or external message is authorized by this lock.
Paper14 is absorbed local provenance and may not be externally submitted in parallel with a later Paper16 manuscript.
PC3 is reproduced as a standalone proof, not cited as an opaque black box or promoted as independent new support-one priority.

items.requirement: State char(K)=0, 1≤e_1<⋯<e_s=d, s≥2 for PC1–PC2, all a,c,b_j nonzero, Γ≤K* of rank r, and coefficients not required in Γ.
Define P(X)=c+Σ b_jX^{e_j}, H(x,y)=(P(x)+ay,x), and T_m with states H^j(Q)∈Γ² for every 0≤j≤m.
Quote Amoroso–Viada Theorem 6.2 only over an algebraic closure and prove the injective arbitrary-characteristic-zero-field bridge with no rank increase and no descent assertion.
Prove the q-term sparse-image lemma with rank at most 2r, d-to-one power recovery, and the full 2^q−q−2 proper-zero-subsum union.
Audit arbitrary torsion: AV uses rank only and polynomial root bounds remain at most d.
For the first PC1 recurrence use Z=z/c, U=−au/c, M_j=−b_jv^{e_j}/c and rank at most 3r; fixed coefficients never enlarge the group.
Treat all four membership patterns GZ, GU, R0, R1, including J=[s] and |J|=1 graph endpoints and the complementary-J convention in R1.
After each R0/R1 root v=ρ, apply the second recurrence w=(c+aρ)+Σb_jz^{e_j}; if the constant cancels, exactly s≥2 terms remain.
Overcount simultaneous vanishing subsums by a full label union; do not assert the four types are disjoint.
Define M(e) by the two explicit subset sums plus 2(2^s−1); closed and crude forms are checksums only.
Prove PC2 for every prescribed support using a=b_j=1, c=−s, Γ=⟨2⟩, and Q_n=(1,2^n).
Reproduce PC3's rank-3r four-index nondegenerate contribution and complete A/B/C automaton, including all nine adjacent words.
Close BA at the third label and close the only exceptional CBA continuation at the fourth under a=−1 and bc^{d−1}=−1; include simultaneous labels.
Prove PC3 sharpness over K=Q(c), c^{d−1}=−1, a=−1, b=1, Γ=⟨2,c,−1⟩ with t=2^n and the exact scalar chain.
Verify the c=0 and a=0 counterexamples and state why support size one has a different replacement window.
Preserve exact citation theorem numbers, bounded-search qualifications, 24 anti-claims, Paper14 absorption/no-parallel rule, and the no-scientific-run lifecycle.

PC1.local_rank: The tuple (z,u,v^{e_1},…,v^{e_s}) is a homomorphic image of Γ³ of rank at most 3r; AV gives A(s+2,3r) nondegenerate tuples and power recovery costs at most d.
PC1.second_step_vertical_closure: For fixed root v=ρ, w=(c+aρ)+Σb_jz^{e_j}; it has s+1 terms if c+aρ≠0 and exactly s≥2 terms if c+aρ=0, so the sparse-image lemma gives at most S*.
PC1.simultaneous_zero_subsums: A point may carry several vanished proper subsums. Choose any one and union over every label; overlap is deliberately overcounted and never omitted.
PC1.statement: For actual support size s≥2, T_2 is uniformly finite with the displayed coefficient-independent bound.

PC2.optional_rank_zero_observation: Over a field containing all roots of unity, Γ=μ_∞ gives a rank-zero analogue; this is not the headline.
PC2.statement: For every prescribed support 1≤e_1<⋯<e_s=d with s≥2, rational nonzero coefficients and a rank-one Γ give infinite T_1.
PC2.threshold_meaning: Together with PC1, two transitions are the shortest coefficient-uniform finite window for every support size s≥2.

automaton.exceptional_chain: Only CBA remains free after three labels, and only under a=−1 and bc^(d−1)=−1; CBAA≤1, CBAB≤d², CBAC≤d²−1 close it at the fourth label.
automaton.free_pairs: Only BA and CB can be free after two labels; every BA continuation closes by the third label.
automaton.simultaneous_labels: Choose any valid A/B/C label at each degenerate index; the 3^4-word union overcounts overlaps and gives at most 81d².

PC3.hypotheses: s=1, P(X)=c+bX^d, d≥2, char(K)=0, a,b,c∈K*, Γ≤K* of rank r.
PC3.nondegenerate_contribution: Four local indices, rank at most 3r, at most A(3,3r) tuples and d power fibers per index: 4d A(3,3r).

sharpness.rank_audit: c and −1 are torsion while 2 has infinite order, so Γ has rank one.
sharpness.statement: For every d≥2, this number-field rank-one example has infinite T_3.

PC3.support_one_window_sharpness: T_4 is uniformly finite while T_3 can be infinite.

amoroso_viada_bridge.application: Choose an algebraic closure Kbar, inject K-solutions into Kbar-solutions, preserve rank of Γ under inclusion, and use ranks at most 2r or 3r for homomorphic tuple images.
amoroso_viada_bridge.theorem_field_scope: Theorem 6.2 is stated over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field.

definitions.base_field: K is an arbitrary field of characteristic zero.
definitions.coefficients: a,c,b_1,…,b_s∈K*; no coefficient-membership assumption in Γ.
definitions.finite_rank_group: Γ≤K* has rank r; finite generation and finite torsion are not assumed.
definitions.support: 1≤e_1<⋯<e_s=d and every b_j≠0; c≠0 is separate; PC1–PC2 assume s≥2.
definitions.window_semantics: T_m has m transitions and m+1 states; T_2 has three states, T_1 two, T_4 five, and T_3 four.

sparse_image_lemma.degenerate_audit: A singleton cannot vanish; there are 2^q−q−2 subsets with 2≤|I|≤q−1, and each nonzero subpolynomial has at most d roots t; u is then unique.
sparse_image_lemma.hypotheses: F(X)=Σ_{ℓ=1}^q f_ℓX^{m_ℓ} has exactly q≥2 nonzero terms, 0≤m_1<⋯<m_q≤d, and λ∈K*.
sparse_image_lemma.nondegenerate_audit: The q-tuple (t^{m_ℓ}u^(−1)) lies in a homomorphic image of Γ² of rank at most 2r; AV gives A(q,2r) tuples, a coordinate ratio recovers t through a power of exponent at most d, and u is unique.
sparse_image_lemma.torsion_audit: Arbitrary torsion is allowed; rank controls AV and the degree-d polynomial root bound controls every fiber.
